corrected_code:
class RedactDocumentWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(document_id, requester_id)
    document = Document.find(document_id)
    user = User.find(requester_id)
    raise 'Forbidden' unless user.can_edit?(document)

    document.apply_redactions!
  end
end

class DocumentsController < ApplicationController
  def redact
    document = current_user.documents.find(params[:id])
    RedactDocumentWorker.perform_async(document.id, current_user.id)
    render json: { status: 'Redaction started' }
  end
end
